node.title: KoalaBear rank-nine moving-root slack boundary
node.statement: For the KoalaBear rate-half support-wise MCA row, every post-C5, post-source-rational, full-outside rank-two record satisfying the printed moving-set and degree contracts has L_(F_eta)|(Pbar+eta Qbar) and nonnegative slacks h+u+ell=s-t-1 with delta_eta<=u. The zero-slack boundary is C5-owned; hence every survivor has s>=67474, reduced degree e>=33737, and full-gcd degree at most 1014838. At first slack only two nonbase linear cells remain.
